checks.finding: design.md's own ## Architecture section (45-120) and Components table (122-158) adequately state top-level component boundaries, existing-component integration, and per-component technology choices. But the package's technology-choice record is NOT consistent across the design + its normative layer-spec refinements: design.md's ## Design Decisions (1292-1315, revised 2026-07-24, human decision-3) and the matching ## Constraint Compliance row (1603) now REQUIRE canonicalize-sdd-yaml.py to use a 'HAND-WRITTEN, stdlib-only, RESTRICTED YAML-SUBSET parser ... no third-party YAML library, no requirements.txt', explicitly retiring the prior PyYAML/ruamel.yaml choice ('that condition FAILED at the actual implementation session ... neither module exists in the target environment'). frontend-spec.md's Technology Stack row (line 17) and Dependencies table (31-33) still state the literal reverse: 'YAML parsing library (canonicalizer's own dependency) | PyYAML or `ruamel.yaml` ... confirmed available at a future implementation session' and 'a hand-rolled parser was considered and rejected in favor of a standard library'. security-spec.md's SBOM and Supply Chain section (169-175) repeats the same stale claim, citing design.md's own 'Design Decisions' for a claim that section no longer makes. An implementer or CI dependency-audit following the layer specs' Dependencies/SBOM sections would add a third-party YAML dependency design.md explicitly forbids, reintroducing the exact permissive-parsing risk ('PyYAML's SafeLoader silently keeps the LAST occurrence of a duplicate key by default') the amendment's own rationale names — a direct, unresolved contradiction of a required constraint for the component the entire HMAC/approval trust chain depends on.

No cycle found. design.md's Technical Summary (11-36) states an explicit, linear REQ-numbered dependency chain: REQ-001/REQ-002 -> REQ-003 -> REQ-004/REQ-006 -> REQ-005/REQ-009; REQ-007 is a precondition every other script depends on; REQ-008 relies on REQ-007's registration; REQ-010 is wired into REQ-009's five entry points; REQ-011 closes every REQ above. The Architecture diagram (45-120) matches this chain with no back-edge from a later-consumed component to an earlier producer. The apparent round-trip HANDSHAKE -> AGENT -> GUARD -> AGENT -> HANDSHAKE (99-105) is an intentional host-mediated challenge/response protocol (runtime data/control flow), not a structural build/import dependency cycle — none of the three requires another to be built first.

Every artifact this epic defines is wholly new; no existing schema, script, or content file is migrated in place.', 436-437) — all three required sub-fields present with explicit rationale.

## API / Contract Plan (439-1030) gives dedicated CLI/schema-contract subsections for 3 of 4 new JSON Schemas (project-context, provider-bindings, approval-sidecar, each a full ```json body) and 4 of 5 new script families (canonicalize-sdd-yaml, generate-approval-sidecar, detect-policy-weakening, apply-human-copy).
